description: Encrypt or decrypt a file or folder with a password via a Python CLI (AES-256-GCM). Password and paths can be prompted, passed as args, or read from SkillCred .env (FOLDER is a comma-separated list). Use when the user asks to password-protect a file or folder, encrypt a directory, decrypt a .fcr archive, or invokes /folder-crypt_*.
